<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data the molecule contains one carbon bearing three oxygens (≈ 88 ppm), three carbons each attached to a single oxygen (≈ 68–70 ppm) and a set of aliphatic carbons (≈ 14–31 ppm). The connected fragments that can be identified from these signals are therefore:
1. a carbon attached to three OH groups – SMILES C(O)(O)O  
2. carbons attached to a single OH – SMILES CO  
3. plain aliphatic carbons – SMILES C  

These three SMILES represent the distinct connected fragments present in the compound.
